description: G2 permeation time-lag oracle: slab with c(0,t)=c0, c(L,t)=0, c(x,0)=0, constant D.
provenance: Params match g1_steady.json (D=1e-9 m^2/s, L=1e-3 m, c0=1.0 mol/m^3). Separation of variables on v=c-c_ss gives J(L,t)/J_ss=1+2*sum_{n>=1}(-1)^n exp(-D n^2 pi^2 t/L^2) (G2); cumulative permeation asymptotes to J_ss(t-L^2/6D), hence t_lag=L^2/6D=166.66666666666663 s. Ratios evaluated in float64 with the series truncated once |term|<1e-18 (term counts recorded); pre-breakthrough entries are ~1e-16 series-residual noise around the true value 0. Solver replay tolerance 1e-6.
